headline: Blackhawks’ Patrick Kane activated from IR, expected to return vs. Sabres
take: Patrick Kane is off injured reserve and expected back against Buffalo, Daily Faceoff reports, after missing the last few games with an upper-body injury. Chicago needs whatever he brings: the Blackhawks are 5-13-1, have been outscored 78-42 and have had only 42% of the expected goals (the quality of chances). Kane's own line is quiet, one goal and nine points in 16 games, with his shooting 2.8 goals below his chances. The bigger story is what's happened around him. At five on five, Chicago has had just 37% of the expected goals with Kane on the ice. Last season in Detroit he scored 57 points in 67 games. One return doesn't fix a team allowing 3.58 expected goals per 60.
